# Z3 variables for each house
name = [Int(f"name_{i}") for i in range(n)]
smoothie = [Int(f"smoothie_{i}") for i in range(n)]
color = [Int(f"color_{i}") for i in range(n)]

for i in range(n):
    s.add(name[i] >= 0, name[i] < n)
    s.add(smoothie[i] >= 0, smoothie[i] < n)
    s.add(color[i] >= 0, color[i] < n)

s.add(Distinct(*smoothie))
s.add(Distinct(*color))

idx_Arnold = names.index("Arnold")

idx_dragonfruit = smoothies.index("dragonfruit")

idx_white = colors.index("white")

idx_yellow = colors.index("yellow")

    s.add(Implies(smoothie[i] == idx_dragonfruit, name[i] == idx_Eric))

    s.add(Implies(name[i] == idx_Peter, color[i] == idx_white))
    s.add(Implies(color[i] == idx_white, name[i] == idx_Peter))

vac_house = {v: Int(f"house_of_{v}") for v in vacations}

           list(nat_house.values()) + list(hair_house.values()) + list(style_house.values())

for v in all_vars:

solver.add(Distinct(*car_house.values()))
solver.add(Distinct(*vac_house.values()))
solver.add(Distinct(*nat_house.values()))
solver.add(Distinct(*hair_house.values()))
solver.add(Distinct(*style_house.values()))

    # Build reverse look‑ups: for each house, find the attribute value whose variable equals that house
